auditScope: Read-only completion audit of existing evidence for master-plan finish-line items (a)-(h). No tests, builds, browser workloads, benchmarks, servers, VMs, source edits, or archive copying were performed.

binding.publicExports: src/native_runtime_api.ts re-exports createNativeFrameLoop and its public types from src/native_frame_loop.ts.

nativeCorrectness.scope: Native-host Darwin ARM64; 80/80 phases, 1308 Deno tests, 107 Rust tests, 60 actual compiled Rust/OXC fixtures. Source audit MATCH; 2320 archive inputs. This is the latest consolidated correctness gate for this source slice, not cross-platform qualification.
nativeCorrectness.receiptChecks: Both referenced JSON files parse. Runner receipt has 80 PASS steps and no failed steps. Source-before and source-after each contain 2310 matching inputs; pre-command archive contains 2320 inputs and no unavailable context entries.

installedUntimedProof.scope: Six headless contexts; 72-frame values, pixels, and retained identities match. 512 resources disposed once per context; source checks match before/after; browser closed. ReactFrame Position/Rotation compile successfully. Public per-frame evidence is group/draw/version advancement; teardown flush counters do not establish per-frame public-queue batch/sweep counts. CSP eval blocking was directly tested on minified and rebundled delivery, not baseline.

installedHmr.scope: Actual Portless HTTPS workbench controls, pause/reset/resume, reduced motion, keyed edit, source revision invalidation, full reload/new realm/remount, resource disposal, exact source restoration, and owned route/listener/process/private-TLS cleanup. No granular state-preserving HMR claim. The earlier HMR v1 failure remains preserved.

soleTimingEpisode.scope: One fixed-order four-arm episode, 12 warmups and 60 measured frames, null diagnostics, one device. Native loses all four median/p95 parity checks against declarative React Compiler/R3F. The primary's read-only Git inventory overlapped the run for about 10.2 seconds; interference magnitude is unknown, so this is descriptive and not quiet-machine qualification. No repeat was performed.
soleTimingEpisode.interpretationLimits: Common draw interval includes WebGL render/readback, not physical presentation. Setup intervals are incomparable. This result must remain a performance FAIL; no causal before/after, cold/memory, independent-device, or presentation claim follows.

finishLine.requirement: Documented native TSX subset, compiler diagnostics, and HMR rule.
finishLine.limit: The documented native subset and conservative HMR behavior do not imply broad React compatibility.

finishLine.requirement: Retained VDOM and one invariant authority across numeric, keyed, Store, and async paths.
finishLine.limit: Current evidence covers retained VDOM, keyed identity/retention, numeric and closed-Store execution, frame publication, and async task/reveal regression suites. A complete current-source audit of one invariant authority across every numeric, keyed, Store, and async path is deferred to primary/Sol; this audit does not infer a missing implementation from historical checkpoint prose.

finishLine.requirement: Coherent accepted-view/acknowledgement and partial-failure contract across DOM and Three.
finishLine.limit: Current frame slice verifies accepted reader receipts, notification acknowledgement, per-frame versions, and Three behavior; consolidated regressions cover DOM and host failure paths. The contract is scoped: arbitrary host rollback and cross-renderer visual atomicity are explicitly outside the promise, not unmet requirements.

finishLine.requirement: Named authored realtime interaction passes frozen median/p95, cold/memory, and independent-device gates without manual per-frame host micromanagement.
finishLine.limit: The sole current-source comparison loses all four median/p95 parity metrics; concurrent read-only inventory makes qualification weaker, not better. Cold/setup/allocation/retained-memory budgets and independent-device replication are missing. No second device is known. Preserve the FAIL; no timing retry is authorized by this audit.

finishLine.requirement: Structural localized edits pass identity/lifetime and integrated performance gates, or a clearly scoped generic fallback with honest cost.
finishLine.limit: The documented route keeps unsupported structural cases on the conservative generic reconciler and states its Θ(M)-class cost; eligible keyed paths have identity/lifetime correctness coverage. Historical move/remove timings are not promoted as current performance qualification. This satisfies the finish-line's explicit generic-fallback alternative.

finishLine.requirement: Useful Suspense/transition behavior compared with equal React preloading and urgent input.
finishLine.limit: Installed async interactions have untimed correctness and one descriptive Native-slower timing observation with equal explicit preload knowledge and urgent actions. This is not a frozen median/p95 UX gate; broad async UX, urgent input-to-present, fallback-flash and conflict/reveal requirements remain open.

finishLine.limit: Public host extension and packaged consumer are demonstrated. finishLine.limit: Human participants remain zero. No maintenance advantage is claimed; no positive maintenance evidence is implied.

conclusion: The evidence audit is ready for primary review. Items b and c require primary/Sol confirmation of the current-source invariant/host contract; the evidence supports their covered paths.
